notice.title: RECRUITMENT OF ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICERS (SCALE I)--GENERALISTS AND HINDI OFFICERS-2026 - Information Handout for the Online Preliminary Examination (Tier-I) (English)

clauses.text: (7) Both the candidate as well as scribe will have to give a suitable undertaking confirming that the scribe fulfils all the stipulated eligibility criteria for a scribe mentioned in the official recruitment notification

Further in case it later transpires that he/she did not fulfill any laid down eligibility criteria or suppressed material facts the candidature of the applicant will stand cancelled, irrespective of the result of the online examination

negative_marking.value: One-fourth of the marks assigned for each wrong answer

duration.value: 60 Minutes The total time for the test is 60 minutes
